notice: All organizations, inputs, activity and results are synthetic. This proposed workflow is not a connected employer system or measured company performance.
title: Connect industry context, alliance ownership and seller action.
intro: A proposed marketing-technology workbench for HSO: turn an industry account hypothesis into a governed, alliance-aware seller handoff.
queueIntro: Fictional enterprise accounts and Microsoft-solution hypotheses only. These scenarios are not HSO customer projects or claims of CJ’s platform-administration experience.
workbenchIntro: Review the account evidence, alliance relationship and proposed CRM fields before preparing a seller action. No connected CRM or campaign is changed.
firstBody: Join sourced industry context with a reviewed solution question, current partner and seller ownership, and a measurable next task.

fields.label: CRM and enrichment field definitions validated
Seller activation task has an owner and measure

rules.title: Define the industry use case
rules.next: Connect the account to a specific operating challenge rather than a generic digital-transformation pitch.

rules.title: Verify the solution context
rules.next: Record what is known about the business application or cloud need without assuming a current platform or implementation scope.

rules.title: Coordinate the alliance relationship
rules.next: Preserve Microsoft alliance context and current seller ownership before creating another handoff.

rules.title: Validate the cross-platform data contract
rules.next: Agree on account keys, lifecycle values and authoritative fields before a proposed Dynamics 365 update.

rules.title: Review the account-specific asset
rules.next: Use approved evidence and an accountable reviewer for personalization and solution claims.

rules.title: Make the handoff actionable
rules.next: Attach a specific next task and an agreed useful-output measure so the seller can act and provide feedback.

ready.title: Ready for a marketing-to-seller review
ready.next: The alliance and seller owners can review the account brief, proposed asset and next action. Solution scope still requires discovery.

experiments.name: Industry-specific seller activation
experiments.hypothesis: A focused business-process question makes the handoff more useful.
experiments.treatment: Industry context, evidence and next task
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

experiments.name: Alliance-aware routing
experiments.hypothesis: Preserving partner ownership reduces duplicate work.
experiments.treatment: Shared account key and relationship review
experiments.guardrail: Partner conflicts and attribution double counting
experiments.allocation: Use matched account cohorts and a fixed observation window. Review uncertainty and selection effects before expansion.

roadmap.title: Map the marketing technology and buyer journey
roadmap.body: Work with Marketing, Sales and alliance stakeholders on data definitions, handoffs and recurring manual tasks.
roadmap.measure: Known integrations and owned process gaps

roadmap.title: Build one reviewed seller-activation workflow
roadmap.body: Pilot sourced research and proposed CRM updates with clear review, failures and documentation.
roadmap.measure: Useful briefs and correct data movement

roadmap.title: Measure and extend the useful patterns
roadmap.body: Compare demand and alliance cohorts through qualified discovery. Reuse documented patterns across industry teams.
roadmap.measure: Qualified outcomes, adoption and maintenance effort
